key.original: vLLM v0.10.2：根据SGLang说明先识别分离阶段的作用，再依据vLLM限制判断能否把解耦直接当作吞吐提升保证。
key.english: vLLM v0.10.2: According to the SGLang description, first identify the role of the disaggregation phase, then based on vLLM limitations determine whether decoupling can be directly treated as a guarantee of throughput improvement.
